definitions.explanation: Used when night ends and day begins. The subject is typically {夜|よる} (night), {朝|あさ} (morning), or {空|そら} (sky).

definitions.gloss: to end; to be over (a period or season)
definitions.explanation: Used when a defined period such as the rainy season, mourning, or a year comes to an end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あ}け⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The eastern sky began to brighten.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あ}ける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動|うご}き{出|だ}した→動き出す：18597_ugokidasu⟧。
examples.english: When dawn broke, the town quietly began to stir.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あ}けた。
⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あ}けて⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
⟦{喪|も}→喪：29103_mo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あ}けたら、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{日常|にちじょう}→日常：01595_nichijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}ろう→戻る：01117_modoru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: Once the mourning period is over, I plan to gradually return to daily life.

notes:
An intransitive verb meaning for a dark or closed period to end and give way to what follows. Not to be confused with ⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧ (to open) or ⟦{空|あ}ける→空ける：18694_akeru⟧ (to empty, to vacate), which are transitive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あ}ける: dawn breaks
- ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あ}ける: a new year begins
- ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あ}ける: the rainy season ends
- ⟦{喪|も}→喪：29103_mo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{明|あ}ける: the mourning period ends
- ⟦{夜|よ}{明|あ}け→夜明け：03655_yoake⟧: dawn, daybreak (noun form)

TRANSITIVITY:
This {明|あ}ける is intransitive — the period or darkness itself ends. There is no direct transitive counterpart with this meaning.

CONTRAST WITH OTHER あける:
- ⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open (a door, a lid) — transitive
- ⟦{空|あ}ける→空ける：18694_akeru⟧: to empty, to vacate (a room, a seat) — transitive
- {明|あ}ける: to dawn, to end (a period) — intransitive (this entry)
